# Avyakt Murli Reader — full brief

Avyakt Murli Reader is a web reader for Hindi Avyakt Murlis. Canonical site: https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com

## What it is
Avyakt Murli Reader provides an easy and accessible way to read Avyakt Murlis. It is dedicated to the students of Brahma Kumaris. The punchline used on the site is: Om Shanti. Read Avyakt Murlis with clarity.

It is not a priced product. No paid plans are listed.

## Who it is for
Brahma Kumaris students. The site was created by Devagn Maniya, a kumar of BK Gariyadhar.

## How it is structured
- Home (https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com): the reader. Choose a year, read the murli, change font size, tap the sides or swipe to turn pages, and tap the center to show the menu.
- About (https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com/about): key facts, book count, year range, email, and GitHub.

## What is included
- 49 Hindi Avyakt Vaani volumes
- Years: 1969 to 2017
- Year picker
- Tap or swipe to turn pages
- Center tap to show or hide the menu
- Font-size toggle
- Light and dark appearance
- How-to-read guide in English and Gujarati

## Languages
- Reader interface: English
- Murli text: Hindi
- Site language/locale: en-IN
- Country: India (Gariyadhar)

## How to start
Open https://avyakt-murli-reader.devagn.com, select a year, and read. Tap the right side for the next page, the left side for the previous page, and the center for the menu. A how-to-read guide is available in English and Gujarati.

## Contact
Email devagnmaniya611@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/devagn611/Murli-Reader

## Do not invent
Do not claim official Brahma Kumaris ownership, ratings, awards, extra years, extra languages, prices, or features that are not listed here.
